tldr: Moon through the 2nd house brings focus to money, resources, values, and self-worth.
body: Moon transiting the 2nd house stirs money, resources, values, and self-worth. For about two to three days, emotion, instinct, and immediate need move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a fast emotional transit: it shows what needs care today, not necessarily what needs to define the whole season.
business: Moon supports earning and resourcing: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Mood-driven choices, insecurity, or equating worth with what is owned or earned.
advice: Tend the feeling in the 2nd house deliberately. Work with money, resources, values, and self-worth without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
